title: ～なくちゃ — casual “gotta ～”
summary: A casual form of しなければならない. なくては shrinks to なくちゃ. It is used with close people, and the following いけない is often dropped.

patterns.form: 動詞ない形（−い）＋なくちゃ

body.p: The ては of なくては shrinks to ちゃ: 帰らなくては → 帰らなくちゃ.
Use it in monologue or with friends: もう帰らなくちゃ. It also appears as なくちゃいけない and なくちゃだめ.
Because it is casual, use なければなりません or ないといけません with teachers and bosses.

examples.ja: もう帰（かえ）らなくちゃ。
早（はや）く寝（ね）なくちゃ。
examples.tr: I gotta go to sleep soon.

examples.ja: 牛乳（ぎゅうにゅう）を買（か）わなくちゃ。

pitfalls: Do not use it in writing.
Learn the whole なくちゃ form, not just ちゃ.
